track_strategy: Invite only past-demo and serious-request prospects to a private beta preview. The sequence earns attention through prior context, three concrete workflows, clean logistics, a brief note from Mark, and an on-demand recording for no-shows. Each message has one primary action. The emails define LUCI and the beta change when product context appears, while logistics and personal notes stay plain.
